text:
deploy-bot: Canary promotion for gateway-api v1.7.8 -> v1.8.0 paused: values changed and image tag 'nightly-202604' maps to multiple digests. Promotion locked.

joan: ugh, duplicate tags again. who's got the QA digest?

luke: QA ran against sha256:aa11...bb22. Registry shows another push sha256:ff33...ee44 at 02:18 UTC.

tanvi: if the newer digest includes a retry fix we need, picking older one regresses. but we can't risk ambiguous tags in prod.

sre-oncall: short-term mitigation: pin digest to QA image and run extended canary (15m) plus DB connection smoke. If any DB errors, abort.

release-coordinator: OK. plan: 1) open overlay PR to set `image.digest: sha256:aa11...bb22`, 2) annotate release with `helm.redwood/allow-promotion: "pin-gateway-1102"`, 3) require `/deploy override pin-gateway-1102` from release-coordinator.

joan: PR opened — https://github.com/redwood-inference/gateway/PR-1102 — sets digest + changelog note. CI green except one flaky integration test.

luke: deploy-bot: created lock candidate `pin-gateway-1102`. Waiting override.

release-coordinator: running `/deploy override pin-gateway-1102` now.

deploy-bot: Override accepted from @release-coordinator. Canary started (4% traffic) in us-east. Extended smoke enabled (15m). Traces and DB checks active.

tanvi: kicking off smoke job: `smoke/gateway --env=canary --checks=db,latency`

(smoke output)
```
2026-05-14T03:11:05Z  health OK
2026-05-14T03:16:22Z  DB pool warnings: transient connection spike (peak=23, baseline=8)
2026-05-14T03:16:38Z  retry succeeded, errors=0
```

sre-oncall: saw transient spike but retries smoothed it. No errors. latency P95 stayed <180ms.

luke: moving to 30% now. updating tracker #DEVOPS-1987 with digests and smoke logs.

joan: reminder to add note in release notes: "Pinned image digest to sha256:aa11...bb22 due to duplicate tag detection; extended canary executed; transient DB connection spike observed and deemed non-blocking."

release-coordinator: finalizing notes and finishing rollout. deploy-bot: complete promotion to 100% and close lockfile `pin-gateway-1102`.

deploy-bot: Promotion completed to 100% in us-east. Lockfile closed. Rollback triggers remain: error rate >2% over 3m.

sre-oncall: filing follow-up infra ticket INFRA-600: prevent duplicate tags for 24h window and add registry push alerts.

joan: will draft runbook update for deploy-bot override steps.

release-coordinator: thread closed — artifacts: PR-1102, #DEVOPS-1987, INFRA-600.
